1 SCOPE
This Standard covers the guidelines for thermal processing of horticulture and wet waste.
2 REFERENCES
The following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standard:
